metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.0 · 1997 · Anaconda
metas.description: A "National Geographic" film crew is taken hostage by an insane hunter, who forces them along on his quest to capture the world's largest - and deadliest - snake.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.8 · 2004 · Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
metas.description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 2.8 · 2008 · Anaconda 3: Offspring
metas.description: A mercenary-for-hire accepts a mission from a billionaire to capture a dangerous snake that could possibly help cure a terminal illness.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 2.9 · 2009 · Anacondas: Trail of Blood
metas.description: A genetically created Anaconda, cut in half, regenerates itself into two aggressive giant snakes, due to the Blood Orchid.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 3.2 · 2015 · Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
metas.description: A giant crocodile goes head to head with a giant anaconda. The town Sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.
